title: Superlatives: the biggest, the most…
grammarNote: ПРЕВОСХОДНАЯ СТЕПЕНЬ прилагательных используется для сравнения ОДНОГО предмета с ГРУППОЙ предметов — чтобы показать, что он самый... (самый высокий, самый красивый, самый страшный). Образуется двумя способами: для коротких прилагательных — the + adj + -est; для длинных — the most + adjective.

grammarTable.subject: 1 syllable (short)
grammarTable.example: big → the biggest · tall → the tallest · old → the oldest · long → the longest

grammarTable.subject: Ends in -e
grammarTable.example: large→the largest · wide→the widest · strange→the strangest

grammarTable.subject: Ends in -y
grammarTable.example: heavy→the heaviest · tiny→the tiniest · noisy→the noisiest

grammarTable.subject: 2+ syllables (long)
grammarTable.example: beautiful→the most beautiful · dangerous→the most dangerous · impressive→the most impressive

grammarTable.subject: Irregular forms
grammarTable.example: good→the best · bad→the worst · far→the furthest · little→the least · much/many→the most

grammarTable.subject: Least (opposite)
grammarTable.example: the least known · the least dangerous · the least common animal on the steppe

grammarTable.subject: Structure
grammarTable.example: the tallest mountain in Kazakhstan · the fastest animal of all · the best in the group

grammarExtra.title: Short adjectives — spelling rules in detail

rows.example: tall → the tallest · cold → the coldest · long → the longest
big → the biggest · hot → the hottest · thin → the thinnest
tiny → the tiniest · heavy → the heaviest · icy → the iciest
large → the largest · wide → the widest · fierce → the fiercest
friendly → the friendliest · deadly → the deadliest · lonely → the loneliest
the furthest point in Kazakhstan · the furthest I've ever travelled
the highest mountain in Central Asia
the most endangered of all Central Asian mammals

rows.form: the + sup. + noun + I've ever + pp
rows.example: the most beautiful animal I've ever seen

rows.form: one of the + sup. + plural noun
rows.example: one of the most important conservation areas in the world
Which is bigger — the saiga or the snow leopard? — The saiga is the bigger of the two.
The saiga is not the most well-known animal, but it is very important.

rows.form: The Caspian Sea is the largest lake in the world.
rows.example: Caspian: 371,000 km² (larger than any other lake)

rows.form: The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
rows.example: Cheetah: 112 km/h — faster than any other land animal

rows.form: The blue whale is the heaviest animal ever.
rows.example: Blue whale: up to 200 tonnes — the heaviest of all

rows.form: The snow leopard is the most elusive big cat.
rows.example: Rarely seen — the most difficult to photograph

rows.form: The saiga is one of the oldest living mammals.
rows.example: Over 2 million years old — older than woolly mammoths

rows.form: Kazakhstan has one of the largest steppes.
rows.example: One of the world's largest remaining grasslands
✅ The tallest mountain. (short adj → -est, NOT most + est!)
✅ The best animal. (irregular: good → the best, not most good)
✅ The biggest leopard. (short adj → -est!)

rows.form: ❌ It is more dangerous of all.
rows.example: ✅ It is the most dangerous of all. (superlative, not comparative!)

grammarTip:
Два правила — как выбрать форму:

① КОРОТКОЕ (1 слог, и большинство 2-слоговых): the + adj + EST
   big → the BIGGEST · tall → the TALLEST · hot → the HOTTEST
   tiny → the TINIEST · heavy → the HEAVIEST

② ДЛИННОЕ (2+ слогов): the MOST + adjective
   beautiful → the MOST BEAUTIFUL · dangerous → the MOST DANGEROUS
   impressive → the MOST IMPRESSIVE

⚠️ НИКОГДА не используй оба сразу:
   ❌ the most tallest · ❌ the most biggest
   ✅ the tallest · ✅ the biggest

💡 Неправильные: good→the BEST · bad→the WORST · far→the FURTHEST

exercises.text: Kazakhstan is one of ___ (large) countries in the world.
exercises.hint: "large" ends in -e → the largest (just add -st). Never "most large" or "most largest".

exercises.text: The saiga antelope is ___ (old) animal on the steppe.
The snow leopard is ___ (beautiful) wild cat in Asia.
exercises.hint: "beautiful" = long adjective (3 syllables) → the most beautiful.

exercises.text: The Altai Mountains are ___ (high) range in Kazakhstan.
exercises.hint: "high" → the highest (short adj, ends in consonant + h → just +est).
Irregular: far → the furthest (or farthest). "Most far" is wrong.

exercises.text: Which is ___ (tiny) mammal in Kazakhstan? The steppe mouse!
exercises.hint: "tiny" ends in -y → change y to i: the tiniest.

opts: The cheetah is the most fastest land animal.
The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
The cheetah is more fast land animal.
The cheetah is most fast animal.
exercises.correct: The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
exercises.hint: "fast" = short → the fastest. Never "most fastest" — don't use both!

exercises.text: The documentary was ___ (impressive) I've ever watched.
The steppe eagle has ___ (wide) wingspan of any eagle in Kazakhstan.
This was ___ documentary about nature I have ever seen.
exercises.hint: Irregular: good → the best. Not "most good" or "goodest".

exercises.text: Choose the sentence that uses "the least" correctly.
opts: The snow leopard is the least common big cat in Kazakhstan.
The snow leopard is the least fast runner.
The snow leopard is the least biggest cat.
The snow leopard is the not most common.
exercises.correct: The snow leopard is the least common big cat in Kazakhstan.
exercises.hint: "the least" = the opposite of "the most". The least common = the rarest.

exercises.text: Kazakhstan is one of ___ (biodiverse) countries in Central Asia.
exercises.hint: "biodiverse" = long adjective → one of the most biodiverse.

questions.hint: "big" = short, CVC → double consonant: the biggest.

questions.text: The snow leopard is ___ (elusive) predator in Asia.
"She is ___ student in the class." (high score)
The saiga is ___ (old) animal on the Kazakh steppe.

questions.hint: far → the furthest (irregular). Also acceptable: the farthest.
Short adj → the tallest. Never "most" AND "-est" together!
"heavy" ends in -y → change to -i: the heaviest.

questions.text: "One of ___ endangered species in the world."
questions.hint: "one of the most + plural noun" — standard structure.

questions.text: The Caspian Sea is ___ (large) lake in the world.

questions.hint: "hot" = short CVC → double t: the hottest.

questions.text: The cheetah is ___ (fast) land animal on Earth.

questions.hint: "the least" = opposite of "the most". Least common = rarest.

questions.text: Kazakhstan is ___ (biodiverse) country I have ever studied.
